headline_marked: End of an era: [[Lionel Messi retires from international football]]
headline: End of an era: Lionel Messi retires from international football
summary: The 39-year-old legend retires after leading Argentina to two consecutive World Cup finals in 2022 and 2026.
details: Lionel Messi announced his retirement from international football on Monday, ending a legendary career with the Argentina national team.
In an Instagram post, the 39-year-old stated that the decision 'hurt deep in my soul' but that he believes it is the right time to step away.
Messi's final international chapter included leading Argentina to victory in the 2022 World Cup final against France and reaching the 2026 final, where they lost 1-0 to Spain.
The decision comes after a period of personal loss, as Messi had previously expressed doubts about his future in football following the death of his father, Jorge, in August.
While he retires from the national team, Messi will continue to play club football for Major League Soccer club Inter Miami through the end of the 2028 season.
caption:
The GOAT steps away. 🐐

Lionel Messi announces his retirement from international football.

Lionel Messi announced his retirement from international football on Monday, ending a legendary career with the Argentina national team.

In an Instagram post, the 39-year-old stated that the decision 'hurt deep in my soul' but that he believes it is the right time to step away.

Messi's final international chapter included leading Argentina to victory in the 2022 World Cup final against France and reaching the 2026 final, where they lost 1-0 to Spain.

The decision comes after a period of personal loss, as Messi had previously expressed doubts about his future in football following the death of his father, Jorge, in August.

While he retires from the national team, Messi will continue to play club football for Major League Soccer club Inter Miami through the end of the 2028 season.

headline: Govt approves new pay scale for public servants
summary: The Cabinet has approved the National Pay Scale 2026, which will be implemented in phases to increase salaries for government employees.
details: The Bangladesh Cabinet has officially approved the proposal for the ninth pay scale, known as the National Pay Scale 2026. This move is set to increase the salaries of all government employees across various grades.
caption:
A major salary hike for government employees is coming. The Cabinet has approved the National Pay Scale 2026.

The Bangladesh Cabinet has officially approved the proposal for the ninth pay scale, known as the National Pay Scale 2026. This move is set to increase the salaries of all government employees across various grades.
